description: Implementation of a basic HTTP server for serving files from assets, handling GET requests, managing socket connections, and parsing HTTP headers.

classes.name: SimpleWebServer
classes.description: A simple, single-threaded HTTP server that serves files from assets. Supports only GET requests and handles requests one at a time.

methods.name: SimpleWebServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server port and AssetManager.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server in a new thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server and closes the server socket.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main server loop accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles individual client socket, parses HTTP request, loads content, and sends response.

methods.name: writeServerError
methods.description: Sends an HTTP 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: loadContent
methods.description: Loads the content of a file from assets into a byte array.

methods.name: detectMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type based on the filename extension.
